name: module-worker.workflow
title: Module Worker durable workflow binding
description: Projects only the caller operations of exact worker.workflow@2.0.0 into a Worker Version; the class run/step callee ABI is not exposed to callers. Runtime surface: env.NAME has create({id?, params?}) and get(id), each returning a Promise<WorkflowInstance>. The handle has WorkflowInstance.id and status(), sendEvent({type, payload?, eventId?}) and terminate() methods. A caller-chosen id is scoped to the DurableWorkflow and makes uncertain create retries observable: a retained id fails instance_exists instead of starting twice. A minted id is not a retry key. get fails unknown_instance if no retained instance holds that id. status resolves to committed {status, output?, error?}; workflow failure is an errored status, not a rejected call. sendEvent resolves only after durable admission. Its optional eventId deduplicates identical canonical events within this retained instance, including after consumption or terminal transition. A conflicting key fails event_conflict, a full inbox fails event_queue_full, and a new event after terminal fails instance_terminal. An unkeyed lost reply may duplicate the event. terminate fences and retires active code before publishing terminated; repeating it on any terminal instance succeeds without changing that outcome. Every operation rejection uses its exact Interface-defined Error.name; the step object is available only to the class, never this Binding.
